mode.title: Mode
enumTitles: Latest open tenders (currently accepting bids, full detail)
Historical tender listing (bulk browse, list-level fields)
Detail lookup (specific resourceId(s) or tender URL(s))
mode.description: 'latest' returns currently-open tenders with full detail. 'list' paginates ZPPA's large historical 'Opened Bid Details' table (title, reference number, procuring entity, deadline, procurement method, status -- no login needed). 'detail' fetches one or more specific tenders by resourceId or URL.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Applies to 'latest' (capped at ~10 by the site's own homepage widget) and 'list' (paginates 10 rows per request -- e.g. 200 fetches ~20 pages).

resourceIds.title: Tender resource IDs
resourceIds.description: Mode 'detail' only. Numeric tender resourceId(s), e.g. "29201439" (found in tender URLs as ?resourceId=...).

tenderUrls.title: Tender URLs
tenderUrls.description: Mode 'detail' only. Full tender detail URLs from eprocure.zppa.org.zm (resourceId is extracted automatically).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: Mode 'detail' only -- how many tender lookups to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Off by default -- no WAF/CAPTCHA was found on this target (confirmed across multiple TLS/browser profiles), so a direct connection works reliably.
